title: Browse colleges and complete GPS-based registration
description: A prospective student can verify campus location and finish zero-PII registration with GPS proof.

steps.description: Navigate to the college list page
Select a college from the available list
Start GPS verification
Provide a campus-valid location proof
Fill in the ghost handle field with a unique value
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the course branch field with a valid value
Fill in the study year field with a valid value
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the authenticated campus experience
Verify a zero-PII profile or recovery key confirmation is shown

title: Create a structured campus issue with media
description: A student can submit a complete campus wall report with required details and evidence.

steps.description: Navigate to the campus wall page
Open the issue creation flow
Fill in the title field with a unique issue title
Fill in the problem description field with a clear issue description
Fill in the exact location field with a campus location
Fill in the impact scope field with a valid scope
Select a problem category
Select a severity level
Attach a valid media file
Choose to hide the ghost handle if available
Submit the issue report
Verify the new issue appears in the campus wall feed
Verify the issue includes attached media evidence

title: Add a college in the admin console
description: The DEV_SUPER_ADMIN can create a new college from the admin console and see it added to the managed colleges list.

steps.description: Navigate to /dev-admin
Open the college management area
Start adding a new college
Fill in the college name with a unique value
Fill in the college slug with a unique value
Fill in the city with a valid value
Fill in the latitude with a valid value
Fill in the longitude with a valid value
Submit the new college
Verify the new college appears in the managed colleges list
Verify the college management update is visible

title: Generate OTP and sign up with classmate verification
description: A student can generate a short-lived OTP and use it to register successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Fill in the authenticated student credentials
Submit the sign-in form
Open the OTP generation flow
Generate a verification code
Open the registration flow
Fill in the college field with a valid value
Fill in the ghost handle field with a unique value
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the OTP field with the generated code
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the authenticated campus experience
Verify a zero-PII profile or recovery key confirmation is shown

title: Ban a user fingerprint from the admin console
description: The DEV_SUPER_ADMIN can ban a user fingerprint and see the ban reflected in the admin console.

steps.description: Navigate to /dev-admin
Open the user ban area
Start a new ban
Fill in the user identifier with a unique value
Fill in the ban reason with a valid value
Submit the ban
Verify the banned user appears in the admin console
Verify the ban status is visible

title: View the developer admin dashboard
description: The DEV_SUPER_ADMIN can open the private console and see the admin dashboard metrics.

steps.description: Navigate to /dev-admin
Verify the admin dashboard metrics are displayed
Verify the private admin console is accessible

title: View current zero-PII profile after sign-in
description: A verified student can log in and see their current anonymous profile details.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Fill in the ghost handle field with a valid account handle
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the hardware fingerprint field with a valid fingerprint hash
Submit the sign-in form
Open the account profile view
Verify the current zero-PII profile is displayed
Verify the college-scoped identity details are visible

title: Escalate an issue to trending after enough support
description: A student repeatedly AYE votes on an issue until it becomes trending and a linked chat room is created.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the verified student
Submit the login form
Open an existing issue from the college wall or issue list
Repeat the AYE action until the issue reaches the trending threshold
Verify the issue status has updated to trending
Verify a linked chat room is available for the issue

title: Block a non-admin from using the admin console
description: A non-DEV_SUPER_ADMIN user is prevented from accessing restricted admin actions.

steps.description: Navigate to /dev-admin
Verify an access denied state is displayed
Verify admin controls are not available

title: Upvote an issue with AYE
description: A student can support an unresolved report and see its AYE total increase.
category: AYE Voting, Junk Flagging, and Crowd Proofs

steps.description: Navigate to the campus wall page
Open an unresolved issue from the feed
Submit an AYE vote
Verify the AYE total is updated
Verify the issue remains visible in the feed

title: Update an issue status in the admin console
description: The DEV_SUPER_ADMIN can change an issue’s status and see the updated status in the issue list.

steps.description: Navigate to /dev-admin
Open the issue management area
Select an issue to update
Change the issue status to a new valid status
Save the status change
Verify the issue status is updated in the issue list
Verify the updated issue state is visible

title: Resolve an issue after the final poll votes
description: A student completes the final resolution poll votes and the issue ends in a resolved or unresolved state based on the outcome.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the verified student
Submit the login form
Open an issue with an active resolution poll
Cast enough resolution poll votes to complete the poll
Verify the issue status has changed to resolved or unresolved
Verify the resolution poll is no longer active

title: Propose a fix with proof for an issue
description: A student submits a fix proposal with proof media and the issue moves into fix-proposed state with a resolution poll available.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the verified student
Submit the login form
Open an existing issue from the college wall or issue list
Submit a fix proposal with proof media and a fix note
Verify the issue status has updated to fix proposed
Verify a resolution poll is available

title: Filter the campus wall to unresolved issues in a category
description: A student can narrow the wall feed to the correct college issues using status and category filters.

steps.description: Navigate to the campus wall page
Open the feed filters
Select the unresolved status filter
Select a specific issue category filter
Apply the filters
Verify the feed shows only matching issues
Verify the filtered results remain college-scoped

Verify the college scoreboard is displayed
Verify resolution metrics and Reality Grade are visible

Submit the login form
Open an issue with an active resolution poll
Cast a resolution poll vote

Verify the issue remains in a resolution-poll state until voting completes

Send a new message

Verify the new message appears in the room

title: Sort unresolved issues from oldest to newest

Open the sorting controls

Apply the sort order

Submit the login form
Open the upload flow

title: Block issue creation with missing required details
description: The wall form prevents submission when required structured fields are omitted.

Open the issue creation flow

Submit the issue report without completing the remaining required fields

Submit the registration form

title: Prevent duplicate junk flags on the same issue

Open a joke or non-serious issue from the feed
Submit a junk flag
Submit the same junk flag again
Verify the first junk flag is recorded
Verify a duplicate-action error is shown

Request the stored file

Verify the download view or file preview is shown
